summary: Design a budgeted actor-reporter test with paired parity-error and activity-response controls.

reconciliation.note: The IBM qualification lacks an admitted runner, sparse full-register collection, frozen carryover and inference contracts, reference allocations and a complete bounded charge; IQM needs an enforceable credit ceiling.

steps.action: Compare targeted prior art and retained experiments
steps.acceptance: Identify nearest published and internal experiments, distinguish the proposed endpoint, and record remaining novelty uncertainty.
Verify exact error-table identities, information controls and counterexamples, then independently review a sampling-bound analyzer for the selected endpoint.
Bind inputs, mappings, intervention, control mutations, execution order and a finite uncertainty and multiplicity contract.

steps.action: Qualify native placement and resource ceilings
steps.acceptance: Measure or conservatively bound current compiled runtime, cost and provider ordering under the independent account limits; retain unresolved billing risks.

steps.action: Design and verify scalable full-register retention
steps.acceptance: Preserve full shared-PUB shots and project only declared outcomes before any dense or int64 conversion; bind raw receipt, physical maps, preparations and compiled identities, check cross-register alignment and missing data, and measure wide-record memory while preserving provider ordering limits.

steps.action: Bind paired-score sampling and confirmation evidence
steps.acceptance: Freeze both same-shot score variances and their joint four-cell law, selection, multiplicity, power and dependence rules; refuse confirmation without authenticated acquisition and validated assumptions.

steps.action: Integrate the candidate with the approved IBM execution path
steps.acceptance: Register the family, bind constructor and analyzer dependencies and compiled layouts to a complete approval record, and account for distinct shot tiers and sub-jobs.
Resolve scientific, implementation, prior-art and accounting findings and bind exact candidate artifacts before fresh admission.

steps.action: Refresh admission and request exact-case approval
steps.acceptance: Present the reviewed case and provider limits; obtain explicit authorization before any job, upload, booking or provider draw.

scope: Design an IBM actor-reporter and paired-error case, with separately admitted IQM, QX and Ascella cases; exact case approval precedes provider actions.
next_action: Freeze qualification tolerances and reference allocations, bind supported ordering and inference evidence, and calculate the complete pilot-through-confirmation ceiling before independent case review.
